{{Top|leg|canon=Superconducting coil}}
'''Superconductive coils''', also known as '''energy projection coils''', were key components in the construction of a [[Universal Energy Cage]]. The coils generated a [[Force field/Legends|force field]]<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> similar to the field used to contain ionized [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] in [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]].<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
